Sports LIVE Updated Just now Live updates: Angel Reese and the Dream lead Valkyries at halftime, 30-24 
 Banner Staff 10/31/2026 4:00 p.m. EDT , Updated 10/31/2026 9:31 p.m. EDT Share Share this via... Save this story in The Banner app Scan this with your phone’s camera to download Angel Reese and Kiah Stokes battle for a loose ball during the first quarter in game seven of the 2026 WNBA Finals. ( Ezra Shaw / Getty Images ) Forget the tricks. The WNBA has a championship treat lined up for basketball fans Saturday night. The Atlanta Dream and Golden State Valkyries meet in Game 7 of the Finals on Halloween, with a championship and a place in league history on the line. And for fans in Maryland , there is an extra reason to keep watching: Angel Reese and Kaila Charles are both chasing the chase. 
 Follow The Banner’s live blog for the drama, the big plays and all the updates.
